info.title: Contoso ERP (Lab - Flow mock)
info.description: Read-only access to Contoso's purchasing system for accounts-payable automation, backed by an in-tenant Power Automate mock. Use this connector to look up a supplier's approval status, retrieve a purchase order with its line items and goods receipts, and post an approved invoice for payment.

post.description: Single entry point to the Contoso ERP mock. The operation parameter selects which ERP function to run.

parameters.name: sp
parameters.description: Shared access permission from the flow trigger URL. Fixed.

parameters.name: sv
parameters.description: Shared access version from the flow trigger URL. Fixed.

parameters.name: sig
parameters.description: Shared access signature from the flow trigger URL. Fixed.

200.description: The ERP responded. Inspect the status field to determine whether the record was found.

operation.description: Which ERP function to run. GetSupplier returns the supplier master record. GetPurchaseOrder returns a purchase order with lines and goods receipts. PostInvoice records an approved invoice for payment.

supplierId.description: Supplier identifier exactly as printed on the invoice, for example SUP-1001.

poNumber.description: Purchase order number exactly as printed on the invoice, for example PO-45001.

supplierInvoiceNumber.description: Invoice number as printed by the supplier. Required for PostInvoice.

currency.description: Invoice currency, ISO 4217. Required for PostInvoice.

totalAmount.description: Total amount to be paid. Required for PostInvoice.

matchResult.description: Outcome that authorised the posting. One of AUTO_CLEAR or APPROVED_EXCEPTION.

approvedBy.description: Email of the human approver, required when matchResult is APPROVED_EXCEPTION.

status.description: Outcome of the lookup. One of Found, NotFound, AlreadyPosted, Posted. Treat NotFound as a business exception, not a technical failure.
Approval status. One of Approved, On Hold, Blocked. Only Approved suppliers may be paid.

paymentTerms.description: Agreed payment terms, for example NET30.

supplierId.description: Supplier the order was placed with.

poStatus.description: Order status. One of Open, Partially Received, Closed, Cancelled. Invoices may only be matched against Open or Partially Received orders.

currency.description: Currency the order was raised in. The invoice currency must match this exactly.

orderDate.description: Date the order was raised, yyyy-MM-dd.

buyerEmail.description: Contoso buyer who raised the order.

sku.description: Item code. Match invoice lines to order lines on this value.

qtyReceived.description: Total quantity received and booked in. Never pay for more than this quantity.

unitPrice.description: Agreed unit price on the order.

lineAmount.description: Ordered quantity multiplied by unit price.

goodsReceipts.description: Goods receipt records. An empty array means nothing has been received.

qtyReceived.description: Quantity booked in on this receipt.
